home.tagline: Your market monster, now with a brain.
home.lead: A paper-trading bot with technical strategies and an AI second opinion, a daily crypto news radar and an on-chain wallet lookup. All open, all explainable.
home.features.bot.title: Paper bot
home.features.bot.text: Moving-average crossover and RSI on real Binance candles. Every simulated order is logged with its reason and, with a key, Claude's verdict.
home.features.news.title: Crypto radar
home.features.news.text: Nine specialised sources, topic tags, a searchable archive and a daily AI-written digest. Refreshes itself every morning.
home.features.wallet.title: Web3 wallet
home.features.wallet.text: Balance of any EVM address on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base or BNB Chain, with a link to the explorer.
home.coins.title: Join in
home.coins.text: The assets from the original prototype, now with live prices.
home.partners.title: Ecosystem
dashboard.title: Market
dashboard.lead: Prices and candles from Binance's public REST, no keys. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
dashboard.empty: No data from the exchange. Is the backend running?
bot.title: Trading bot
bot.lead: Paper trading: simulated money on real prices. Each tick evaluates the strategy on every pair and records the decision.
bot.resetConfirm: Delete all trades and return to the starting balance?
bot.llm: Ask Claude for a second opinion
bot.llmOff: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the backend: signals execute without review.
bot.noTrades: No trades yet. Run a tick.
bot.noDecisions: The bot hasn't evaluated anything yet.
news.title: News radar
news.lead: Headlines from crypto media, tagged by topic. Claude writes the digest every morning when a key is configured.
news.empty: No news yet. Hit “Refresh now” or wait for the daily run.
wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.lead: Native balance of any EVM address. Read-only: nothing is signed here.
wallet.hint: Without WEB3_RPC_URL on the backend, public nodes are used; they may rate-limit.
